reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new temporal motion — the car pulling forward out of the dark — so the action is owned by the request; there is no visual reference to observe it from.
reasons.medium: Only an audio reference is attached, so no visual rendering medium is observed or available to govern; the request side owns the medium.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference and no subject plate exist, so no observed clothing or accessories can be retained; wardrobe falls to the request, which specifies no garment properties.
reasons.lighting: With no visual reference supplying an observed light setup, lighting is request-governed; 'out of the dark' only gestures at a low-light ambient setting and names no source, direction or visible light quality, so it does not further pin the lighting.
reasons.framing: No visual reference provides an observed camera composition, so framing is request-governed; the brief names no shot scale, angle or camera movement, and the 16:9 canvas plus forward travel of the car are not framing instructions.
reasons.palette: No visual reference offers an observed colour palette, so palette is request-governed; the request states no scene colour scheme, and darkness is an ambient condition rather than a specified palette.
